data.name: Raufi
data.gender_notes: Raufi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is content with Allah's decree, pleased with Allah, and satisfied with His provision. The name Raufi carries the meaning “He who is content” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Raufi usually hope their child will grow to embody he who is content and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have submitted to Allah's will and are content with His decree
data.etymology: Raufi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “He who is content.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raufi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رعوفي
in_arabic.meaning: الرعوفِيُّ مِن أَسماء الله الحُسنى، يعني الراحِم الشَّفيع
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرعوفِيُّ مِن أَسماء الله الحُسنى، يعني الراحِم الشَّفيع الذي يَرْحم عباده ويرعاهم، ويُشفي صدورهم من الغلِّ والحقد. وقد ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة هود: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالنُّجِيَّةَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالِإِيمَانَ وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ أُمِّهِ رَسُولًا رَءُوفًا رَحِيمًا

in_english.name: Raufi
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's attributes, meaning merciful, intercessor
in_english.long_meaning: Raufi is one of the attributes of Allah, meaning merciful, intercessor, who shows mercy to His servants and intercedes on their behalf. This name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Imran. Raufi signifies the merciful one, who heals the hearts of people. The root 'R-F-W' in Arabic relates to tenderness, compassion, and care. Historically, the term has been used to describe the benevolent nature of Allah. In Islamic tradition, Raufi represents a personality trait of being compassionate, empathetic, and caring towards others.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rauf" or "Raufi" is of Arabic origin and is common among Muslims, particularly those from the Middle East and South Asia. It is derived from the Arabic root "raafa" which means to be pleased, content, or satisfied. The name is a reminder of the importance of inner peace and acceptance of Allah's decrees in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rauf" or "Raufi" holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It represents a person who has surrendered completely to Allah and is content with His will. The name is a reminder to seek the pleasures of the Hereafter over materialistic gains and to find satisfaction and happiness in the love and approval of Allah alone. It is a name that embodies the Islamic concept of Tawakkul (complete trust and reliance on Allah) and encourages us to seek inner peace and tranquility through faith and submission to Allah's will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "He who is content" symbolizes One who is content with Allah's decree, pleased with Allah, and satisfied with His provision.
